about_the_game:
Strategise, Serve, Protect, Survive and Collect in this visually stunning and exciting twist on a roguelike deckbuilder.

In A Recipe for Survival you must traverse 3 turbulent weeks, serving customers by day and protecting your restaurant by night. All while you uncover the mystery of what is causing the strange events in Whiskerwell and develop your own recipe for survival!

Develop your 2 decks and make decisions that impact both decks simultaneously, it is important to consider the impact any choice you might make on both your day and night!

During the day you must act as head chef of a team of kitty cooks! By serving the customers you can earn tips and stop them becoming angry when they transform into monsters while darkness falls.

At night, the same customers you worked so hard to serve come back, but they are no longer human! Under the light of the moon, they have turned into various mythological creatures from all over the world. They have been sent to take over your restaurant!

Survive the week and defeat powerful bosses assisted by your cat chefs! These bosses are a real challenge and will allow your restaurant to grow! By defeating the final boss your restaurant will be granted an esteemed Mitchel Star!

Winning runs will grant you exciting powerups that you can use in your next adventure! These have game changing abilities that affect everything from the food you cook to the enemies' lifeforce.
